skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Willpower
skins.content: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Willpower. Classic Siracusan womenswear. By request of Texas, all parts once white have been dyed completely black.
skins.quote: The will of the Texas family she should have enforced.

skins.name: Winter Messenger
skins.content:
LIMITED EDITION
Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Winter Messenger. Comfortable and close-fitting with handmade details, it provides complete protection by applying durable and warm fabric that is both waterproof and windproof, making it the best choice for daily occasions.
skins.quote: Life, is all about doing whatever you want.
